subject: general
question: Which of the following banks removed the minimum balance requirement for all savings accounts in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Canara Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In a major move aimed at enhancing financial inclusion, Canara Bank officially removed the Average Monthly Balance (AMB) requirement for all categories of its savings bank accounts starting 1 June 2025.
 
• Announced on 31 May 2025 that effective from the following day (1 June), it would abolish all penalties for non-maintenance of a minimum balance across regular, salary, and NRI savings accounts.
 
• This made it the first prominent public sector bank to implement such a comprehensive blanket waiver in 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **State Bank of India (SBI):** It is the **largest public sector bank** in India and a **Fortune 500** company, headquartered in **Mumbai**, **Maharashtra**.
 
• **Historical Background:** The bank traces its ancestry to the **Bank of Calcutta** (founded in **1806**). It later became the **Imperial Bank of India** in **1921** and was nationalized as the **State Bank of India** on **July 1, 1955**.
 
• **Network and Scale:** SBI possesses a massive network of over **22,400 branches** and more than **65,000 ATMs** across India, holding nearly **25%** of the total market share in loans and deposits.
 
• **Global Footprint:** It is one of the few Indian banks with a strong international presence, operating over **230 offices** in **30 countries**, including major hubs like **New York**, **London**, and **Tokyo**.
 
• **Leadership:** The current **Chairman** of the State Bank of India is **Challa Sreenivasulu Setty** (appointed in **2024**), who succeeded **Dinesh Kumar Khara**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **YONO App:** SBI launched its integrated digital banking platform **YONO (You Only Need One)** in **November 2017**, providing a one-stop solution for banking, shopping, and investments.
 
• **Merger of Associates:** On **April 1, 2017**, SBI merged with **five** of its associate banks (State Bank of Bikaner & Jaipur, Hyderabad, Mysore, Patiala, and Travancore) and the **Bhartiya Mahila Bank**, propelling it into the **Top 50** global banks list.
 
• **Financial Inclusion:** SBI plays a pivotal role in the **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)**, opening the highest number of **zero-balance accounts** to support the government's financial inclusion drive.
 
• **Taglines:** The bank is known by several popular taglines, including **"The Banker to Every Indian"**, **"The Nation banks on us"**, and **"Pure Banking Nothing Else"**.
 
• **Subsidiaries:** The bank has successful subsidiaries like **SBI Card** (credit cards), **SBI Life Insurance**, and **SBI Mutual Fund**, which contribute significantly to the **Indian financial ecosystem**.
